Who they are

Whop is a platform to create and run digital businesses in one place — storefronts, checkout/payments, paid communities, courses, memberships and trading/community groups, now AI-assisted ('Create or run businesses with AI'). Founded 2021 (Steven Schwartz, Cameron Zoub, Jack Sharkey); has paid out $4.6B+ to businesses on the platform. No monthly fee; ~2.7% transaction fee.

What they want

  • (No formal UGC brief beyond the job post — angle inferred from the product + the 'Whop Creators / High Volume UGC, $35/video' listing; swap in the real brief anytime.)
  • Angle to model: 'make money online' / start-a-business content that bridges into Whop — spin up a storefront or paid community and actually get paid, side-hustle / digital-product / faceless-income transformations, 'I built a business in minutes'.
  • Why it converts: Whop removes the friction of stitching tools together — lead with a relatable 'I wanted to sell X but didn't know how' moment, then show going live and getting paid on Whop.
  • Study below: the competitor cards + keyword sections show the creator-monetization / make-money-online formats that go viral, so you can replicate the winners.
